subject.title: fix(control-ui): resolve Personal card avatar 401 via data URI

question: Should maintainers consolidate this bug on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 after its SDK-surface blocker is fixed, or ask this contributor to rebase and repair this narrower branch?
rationale: Automation can identify this PR's proof, type, and conflict blockers, but choosing the canonical landing vehicle and avatar payload strategy across overlapping PRs requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader candidate
options.body: Fix https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634's SDK-surface blocker first, then use it as the canonical backend/bootstrap/UI avatar fix and close this stale branch after the replacement is safe.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Ask this contributor to rebase onto current main, port the UI change to `ui/src/pages/config/quick.ts`, fix the type/lint blockers, add focused coverage, and provide browser/network proof.

options.title: Pause for owner choice
options.body: Keep both branches open until an avatar/UI owner chooses data-URI projection versus authenticated blob loading as the permanent compatibility shape.
